name: Airline API — Auto Test Generator & Runner

nodes.name: Schedule Trigger
nodes.notes: Runs every 6 hours. Can also be triggered manually.

nodes.name: Fetch OpenAPI Spec
nodes.notes: Pulls the live Swagger JSON — this drives ALL test generation. No endpoints are hardcoded.

nodes.name: Parse Spec + Generate All Test Cases
nodes.notes: Reads the OpenAPI spec and auto-generates positive/negative/boundary/auth test cases for EVERY endpoint. No endpoints hardcoded.

nodes.name: Split Into Individual Test Cases
nodes.notes: Converts the testCases array into separate n8n items — one per test case — for the loop.

nodes.name: Loop: One Test Case at a Time
nodes.notes: Processes test cases one by one. Batch size = 1 ensures sequential execution and allows token refresh between calls.

nodes.name: Inject Access Token
nodes.notes: Replaces __ACCESS_TOKEN__ placeholder with the live JWT before each request. Picks up refreshed tokens automatically.

nodes.name: Execute HTTP Request (Dynamic)
nodes.notes: THE only HTTP node in the entire workflow. Method, URL, headers, query params, and body are all injected dynamically from the test case. Works for every endpoint automatically.

nodes.name: Validate Response
nodes.notes: Checks: (1) HTTP status == expectedStatus, (2) SLA not exceeded. Marks passed/failed without throwing.

nodes.name: Unexpected 401? (Token Expired)
nodes.notes: Detects an unexpected 401 on non-auth test cases — means the access token expired. Routes to token refresh.

nodes.name: Refresh Token
nodes.notes: POST /api/auth/refresh — rotates both access and refresh tokens. Triggered automatically on unexpected 401.

nodes.name: Merge (Continue Loop)
nodes.notes: Merges the normal path and post-refresh path back together to continue the loop.

nodes.name: Aggregate All Results
nodes.notes: Waits for all test cases to finish, then passes the full results array to the reporter.

nodes.name: Generate Test Report
nodes.notes: Computes pass rate, SLA violations, breakdown by test type and endpoint. Feeds into Jira/Slack nodes.

values.content: You are an expert airline API QA analyst. Classify API test failures with precision.

=Analyse these airline API test failures:

{{ JSON.stringify($json.failedDetails, null, 2) }}

For each failure classify into:
- CONTRACT_BREACH: schema/contract violation
- AUTH_FAILURE: authentication/authorization bug
- ENVIRONMENT_ISSUE: infra/network/config problem
- LOGIC_ERROR: business logic bug
- SLA_VIOLATION: response time exceeded

Return JSON array: [{ testId, classification, severity (P1/P2/P3), rootCause, suggestedFix }]

nodes.name: AI: Root Cause Classification
nodes.notes: GPT-4o classifies each failure: CONTRACT_BREACH / AUTH_FAILURE / ENVIRONMENT_ISSUE / LOGIC_ERROR / SLA_VIOLATION

parameters.summary: =[AUTO-TEST FAILURE] {{ $('Generate Test Report').first().json.summary.runId }} — {{ $('Generate Test Report').first().json.summary.failed }} test(s) failed ({{ $('Generate Test Report').first().json.summary.passRate }} pass rate)

nodes.name: Create Jira Issue
nodes.notes: Auto-creates a Jira bug with full diagnostics + AI root cause. Only fires on test failures.

nodes.name: Logout & Revoke Tokens
nodes.notes: POST /api/auth/logout — revokes the refresh token so it cannot be reused.

_architecture.keyDesign: Single dynamic HTTP Request node (n09) executes ALL test cases. Method, URL, headers, body and query params are injected from the test case object at runtime.
_architecture.autoGeneration: The Code node n05 reads the OpenAPI spec and generates positive/negative/boundary/auth test cases for EVERY endpoint — no manual configuration per endpoint.
_architecture.tokenRotation: Access token is auto-refreshed mid-loop when an unexpected 401 is detected. Auth-type test cases that intentionally expect 401/403 are excluded from this logic.
